entries.state_summary: The strict BSD-A1a1 context, memory review and seven-event pre-candidate trace are already merged and executable; the bounded primary-source search exposed an overlooked functional-equation parity constraint on the theta augmentation order.
entries.action_summary: Propose BSD-A1a1-C001: under the exact good-ordinary/root-sign/source hypotheses, the Chida-Hsieh theta functional equation forces ord_J Theta_{f/K} to be even; combined with the source-proved positive order this gives ord_J Theta_{f/K} >= 2.
evidence_pointers: Castella-Hsieh, Forum Math. Sigma 10 (2022), Section 5.3, DOI 10.1017/fms.2021.85
alternatives_considered: continue searching only for a direct s-to-T exact-order theorem
import a p-adic BSD/main-conjecture exact-order statement
derive only the functional-equation parity consequence before attempting exactness
entries.decision_rationale: The parity consequence uses a source theorem already inside the frozen method family, adds no root-strength arithmetic assumption, and has a decisive associated-graded proof; it therefore has higher information value than another broad search iteration.
uncertainties: the corollary may be known or implicit in the anticyclotomic literature; no novelty authority is requested
exact order two still requires excluding orders 4,6,...
residuals: exact order two is not established
next_steps: run sign, p=2, zero-theta, unit-factor and associated-graded falsifiers

entries.state_summary: BSD-A1a1-C001 is a one-variable Iwasawa-algebra parity claim, so the cheapest hostile tests are cases that change the functional-equation sign, coefficient characteristic, theta nonvanishing, or augmentation-one unit hypothesis.
entries.action_summary: Stress-test the candidate against sign -1, p=2, Theta=0, a unit with nonunit augmentation, and the exact involution T -> (1+T)^(-1)-1 on J^r/J^(r+1).
alternatives_considered: treat the functional equation as equality without inspecting the leading graded piece
test only selected numerical elliptic curves
entries.decision_rationale: The hostile cases isolate every load-bearing hypothesis of the short proof and distinguish a theorem about sign +1 from a false sign-independent parity statement.
uncertainties: the source normalization of the exact theta element must match the cited functional equation; the proof is scoped to the trivial-character one-variable element
next_steps: record the exact source-scoped result and remaining higher-even-order residual

entries.state_summary: The hostile audit preserves the candidate exactly in the intended source scope and refutes every attempted overgeneralization.
entries.action_summary: Record BSD-A1a1-C001 as a source-bound derived local lemma: for the trivial-character anticyclotomic theta element in the Castella-Hsieh setup with E root number +1 and p>3 good ordinary, r=ord_J Theta is even; since the source already proves r>0 and Theta nonzero, r>=2.
entries.decision_rationale: On the associated graded, inversion acts by (-1)^r, the group-like factor has augmentation one, and the functional-equation sign is +1 in the registered root-sign/good-prime setting; p>3 makes 2 a unit. Therefore odd r is impossible. Castella-Hsieh supplies finite r and r>0.
uncertainties: no arithmetic implication to Mordell-Weil rank is created
residuals: higher even theta order remains possible
next_steps: open a fresh residual focused on excluding r>=4 without root-strength arithmetic input

entries.state_summary: The direct theta-order problem is strictly sharper after C001: positive order is no longer the live uncertainty; only excess even vanishing beyond two remains.
entries.action_summary: Open BSD-A1a1b-HIGHER-EVEN-ORDER-EXCLUSION: determine whether any source-bound analytic/automorphic mechanism can rule out ord_J Theta_{f/K}>=4 under exact complex analytic rank two and admissible auxiliary data without assuming positive Mordell-Weil rank, Selmer dimension two, p-adic BSD, a main conjecture at equivalent strength, or maximal p-adic-height nondegeneracy.
alternatives_considered: keep the old generic s-to-T exact-order search unchanged
factor exactness into parity lower bound plus higher-even-order exclusion
entries.decision_rationale: The parity lemma removes all odd orders without arithmetic-rank input. The remaining question is now an upper-bound/nondegeneracy problem, which is structurally different and must receive a fresh context packet before candidate generation.
uncertainties: existing p-adic BSD formulations may characterize the residual using Selmer ranks and derived-height nondegeneracy, but importing those conditions must be strength-audited
residuals: exclude r>=4 noncircularly or classify the residual as arithmetic-strength/root-like
next_steps: freeze a fresh MathContextFiber, memory review, expert cell and pre-candidate trace for BSD-A1a1b
